actions.action: Select target journal and article type
actions.evidence_needed: Current official author instructions and scope

actions.action: Approve author order, affiliations, ORCIDs and CRediT roles
Approve funding, conflicts, acknowledgements and assistance disclosure
Privately verify PhysioNet registered access/DUA and consent-waiver wording
actions.evidence_needed: Private access record and target-journal policy; no credentials in repository

actions.action: Approve the unvalidated engineering boundary for mapping, segmentation, target and single-case numerical scope
actions.evidence_needed: Signed manuscript review or new independent physical, anatomical or numerical evidence

actions.action: Freeze immutable source revision and release version
Mint and report archive DOI or stable accession
Freeze a development/test dependency lock and run the full non-solver test suite
actions.evidence_needed: Pinned test runner and retained test report

actions.action: Perform final line-numbered manuscript and supplement review
actions.evidence_needed: Author sign-off retaining all failed endpoints and limitations

claim_boundary: Completing administrative actions does not upgrade nonpassing H115 results or validate Case079 physics.
